response.sql: WITH driver_averages AS (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS total_points, AVG(CASE WHEN TRIM(laps) NOT IN ('', '\N') THEN CAST(laps AS REAL) END) AS average_laps FROM results WHERE grid >= 12 GROUP BY driverId) SELECT AVG(total_points) AS average_points_total, AVG(average_laps) AS average_of_average_laps FROM driver_averages
